answer.text: Average absolute difference between portfolio and benchmark returns
Standard deviation of differential returns (Rp - Rb)

explanation.text: The Logic: Tracking Error is the standard deviation of differential returns between the portfolio total return and the benchmark total return, i.e. sigma(Rp - Rb). The Trap: The average of the differences is the active return; tracking error captures the volatility of those differences, not their mean. Note: Definition per NISM-XXI-B workbook (p.373-374).
